components.payments: Paying for an order: UPI, cards, wallets, failed or stuck payments, money debited, double charges, promo codes at checkout
components.delivery: Getting the order to the door: late delivery, order marked delivered but not received, delivery partner behaviour
components.order_accuracy: What arrived versus what was ordered: missing items, wrong items, wrong quantity
components.product_quality: Condition of the items: expired, stale, rotten, damaged, leaking or spilled products
components.refunds: Getting money back after a cancellation or return: refund not received, refund delayed, refund amount wrong
components.account_app: Using the app and account: login OTP, app crashes, bugs, saving addresses, profile
components.support: Customer support itself: chatbot loops, cannot reach a human, no callback, unhelpful agents

impact_levels: Blocked: could not use the service or get the order
Harmed: lost money, health or safety at risk

baseline.note: Projected from token counts at list price; one call per complaint at a measured 1.9s per call. The baseline itself was not run.

/cost.note: Token counts and timings are as reported by the providers.
